summary: Separate swapchain release success from cached-visible content commitment so incomplete/invalid releases cannot inherit same-generation commit proof.

C0_RECOVER.evidence: Recovered latest GitHub HEAD c0f95a32e722e1b162c93be75323212938cbe407 after CONVERSION-DX9EX-00464 exact-SHA PASS bookkeeping. Structural extraction remains terminal and Architecture v3 remains HMD-gated.

C1_REVIEW.evidence: R19 Release marked committedGeneration on every successful xrReleaseSwapchainImage, even when the caller had an invalid RTV index or RenderTo returned false. Because cached-visible fallback keys on generation-level release proof, an incomplete image released within the same generation could retain or recreate commit evidence.

C2_IMPLEMENT.evidence: Release now requires explicit contentComplete provenance. Successful release commits generation only for complete content; cleanup releases pass false; hard release failure clears committedGeneration before setting releaseFaulted. R24 projection/flat/emergency paths use the same explicit contract.
